20 OCTOBER · FOR MY FAVOURITE WEIRDO

Until I can hold you again

Happy 21st birthday, my love. ♡

I wish I could be beside you today, annoying you, making you roll your eyes, and pulling you into the longest hug. Since San Diego put an ocean between us, I made you something for every kind of day: when you miss me, need reassurance, want to laugh, or just want to hear my voice.

On 8 January, you won’t be a face on my screen anymore. I’ll be at the airport in Japan, kissing you properly and refusing to let go. Until then, open whichever letter feels right and imagine me there with you.

Always yours, Dhruv
